controls_equivalence.discrete_policy: Exact per-image match/miss/unmatched/duplicate IDs, counts, and per-row endpoint threshold states across all four references; raw and postclip.

projection.meaning: Compact output retains aggregates, all paired gain/loss identities, oracle additions, empty scenes, and input provenance. Per-image count rows are optional; full fused arrays are reproducible with --write-fused-predictions.

protocol.fusion: Concatenate per-view raw arrays already native-NMS and clipped to original image; identity first for equal-score ties. Apply classwise score-ordered greedy NMS with IoU>0.70 suppression, cap at300, then original postclip NMS0.70 (verified idempotent). Preserve each retained full bbox and original landmark pair.
protocol.identity_control: PR150 control used consistently; PR149 control discrete outcomes agree
protocol.native_output_limit: Caches do not contain pre-native-NMS or sub0.13 proposals, so this is not a reconstruction of joint native decoded-proposal fusion.
protocol.oracle_union: Retrospective union of reference-specific successes in the separate original-view matchings; ceiling only for an oracle choosing among those already scored successful rows, not an attainable predictor or a universal bound on new assignments.
protocol.pair_definition: All offered pairs denominator; all eligible two-v2 reference fronts recall denominator; rematch offered predictions against all reference fronts. Unavailable/unmatched outputs unverified, not all proven physical errors.
